title: ENVIRONMENTAL SAFETY AND QUALITY IMPROVEMENT
knowledge: Discuss the nurse's role and responsibility in maintaining a Safe environment for patients, visitors and staff and why knowing about QI is important.
Explore the potential Hazards in area of work e.g. electrical socket near water, bio mechanic issues (ergonomics).
Identify emergency electrical sockets and power facility and any common electrical hazards in the area.
Describe the placement and how to calibrate (if necessary of any alarms within the area of work or practice.
Identify location of electrical panels, emergency power outlets and electrical backups.
Explain the impact of "noise pollution" within the hospital environment.
Discuss the precautions for preventing electrical shocks and describe the immediate action for someone who received an electrical shock.
Describe the impact of trusting and respectful working relationships within the work place.
Discuss the impact of Bullying on the team and reporting mechanisms in the organization to address this.
Explain what the National Database of Nursing Quality Indicators (NDNQI) is and why it is important.
Discuss the Rationale for using the Robinson Equipment Checklist to ensure patient safety.
skills: Demonstrate response to alarms within area of practice.
Demonstrate initial action for anyone receiving an electrical shock in area of practice and complete the reporting process
Demonstrate how to complete environmental checklist as appropriate for area of practice
Demonstrate how to check electrical sockets, wire and equipment for signs of wear and complete the reporting and documentation process for repair
Complete the necessary reporting and documentation needed to report bullying in the workplace
Demonstrate how to use the Robinson Equipment Checklist to ensure patient safety.
attitude: Show commitment towards eliminating any bullying or disrespectful behavior within area of practice amongst the Inter-professional team.
Show a belief that the environment created in the ward/ department can affect the safety and quality of care given to patients.
Show commitment towards improving self-awareness amongst colleagues and how this helps to improve the working environment for staff as well as patients etc.
Demonstrate ability to organize and facilitate a reflection session in and on practice after any safety issue is highlighted and activate findings to improve future practice and response.
Display proactivity towards safety in the work environment.
